tldr: Email inboxes send replies in a branded e-mail layout set through the API. The account flag branded_email_templates turns the feature on. It is off by default.
goal: Replies from e-mail inboxes need the brand of the account or the inbox.

story.heading: Inboxes store their own branded layout
story.body: An e-mail inbox stores an optional layout that overrides the account layout.

story.heading: E-mail delivery renders replies in branded layouts
story.body: Eligible e-mail replies use the inbox layout, or the account layout, when the flag is on.

story.heading: REST API adds the account layout endpoint
story.body: Admins read and set the account layout through a new endpoint. Inbox updates accept a layout too.

story.heading: Account layout updates check the flag first
story.body: The update checks the account flag, then saves or deletes the account layout template.

story.heading: Email templates gain an inbox scope
story.body: Each template row belongs to an account, an inbox, or neither, with a unique index per scope.

story.heading: Layouts resolve from inbox to account to installation
story.body: Email replies use the inbox layout first, then the account layout, then the installation layout.

components.summary: Adds the account layout endpoint and accepts an inbox layout in inbox updates.
Stores the inbox layout and resolves the effective layout for an inbox.
Wraps reply e-mails in the branded layout when the flag is on and a layout exists.
Adds inbox_id to email templates and removes the stale insert_article_in_reply default.

decisions.title: Store all layout scopes in one table
decisions.why: Account, inbox and installation layouts share one table, so the resolver uses one lookup per scope.

decisions.title: Gate the layout behind an account feature flag
decisions.why: The flag keeps the feature off until an admin enables it for an account.

flows.title: Reply to a conversation by e-mail
Update the account branded e-mail layout
